note: Paraphrased primary/indexed source observations; raw public catalog query evidence is separately retained. No source excerpt is a successful catalog query.

nlv.claim: Over 2.5 million monograph items. Undated inventory statement, not a verified 2026 total. Digitized pages are a separate measure.

hanoi.claim: 600,272 printed book copies as of June 2026. Foreign-language and local-history holdings are subsets.

hanoi-platform.claim: Current introduction explicitly names web-based SLIB; historical Libol customer lists must not override current institutional evidence.

haiphong.claim: Over 600,000 book copies across two facilities after the July 2025 merger of Haiphong and Hai Duong libraries. Queried catalog identifies only 213A Lach Tray; coverage of Hai Duong is unproven.

khanhhoa.claim: Current site2 counters show 90,934 monograph records and 177,244 shelving entries. Footer identifies Khanh Hoa Provincial Library site2, Phan Rang; record holdings retain TvNinhThuan.

hue.claim: Over 25,000 printed titles spanning books, newspapers and journals, not a pure book-volume total. Only the central collection at 20 Le Loi is selected.

husc.claim: Distinct university library at 77 Nguyen Hue; four-storey building and 12 staff. Official institutional proxy; no current aggregate book stock claimed.

dhhp.claim: Full university information-library center at building C4; joined the 94-member shared DIGITAL library in September 2024, contributing nearly 3,000 digital resources. This supports institutional importance but is NOT its print inventory.

bdu.claim: 2017 self-assessment, printed p125/PDF p132: main campus 10,372 textbook/reference titles, 26,760 copies. Ca Mau separately had 1,404 titles/4,886 copies; not added to the tested main catalog scope. Historical, not current stock.

bdu-platform.claim: Current institutional help explicitly names PSC zLIS7.0; 2017 Libol6 statement is historical.

huflit.claim: 61,595 catalog documents across three campuses; mixed formats, not 61,595 physical copies.

ntu.claim: Public counters: 24,270 print records, including 13,333 Vietnamese-book records, 1,222 foreign-book records and 179 NTU books/lectures. Theses and periodicals are also in the print total.

huaf.claim: University agriculture/forestry library with discipline-specific shelves. No reliable current stock established; detail holdings labelled OPAC thử nghiệm.

libol.claim: Vendor describes Libol and lists major public/university customers. Undated/historical client list is adoption evidence, not current deployments or national share.

ilib.claim: CMC describes iLib8 for public, university and specialist libraries, with Vietnamese processing. Product presence, not a market-share census.

koha.claim: D&L claims more than 30 Koha clients across Vietnam AND Southeast Asia; this does not establish 30 Vietnam installations.

hcmc.claim: Official public-system guide describes central library +21 district libraries +Thu Duc, but later retains older 24-district text. Shared search supports institution/location/status filtering. Network size is dated/inconsistent and not a 2026 census.

vnuhcm.claim: HCMUS 2024 student handbook describes Sierra and EDS shared discovery across nine VNUHCM libraries.

ctu.claim: Print stock 144,831 titles /314,473 copies at31 December2021; ebooks/databases separately counted.

hust.claim: 2022-23 disclosure: textbooks236,247 copies, Vietnamese references31,326 copies, foreign books127,576 copies, separately from theses and digital subscriptions.

hongduc.claim: 2024 accreditation report cites22,487 titles/156,447 copies; digital shared resources separate.
